gate.discriminative_pixel_threshold: at least 37 of 44, positive mean advantage, and more wins than control
gate.whole_frame_threshold: at least 33 of 44 and positive mean advantage

finding: The general focused loss exposes a transferable action-specific signal, and inverse assistance improves win count on the sparse discriminative pixels. It does not establish reliable next-screen prediction: the selected model fails the preregistered whole-frame gate, and its mean whole-frame advantage favors the wrong action.
limitations: Same task families with a new seed range; not an unseen environment or user desktop.
Seed-100 exploratory results informed candidate selection, so only seed 200 was frozen before this transfer score.
The 44 evaluated groups are selected for visually distinct outcomes; four attempted eval seeds were skipped under the pinned collector rule.
Neither action-difference accuracy nor inverse after-screen localization proves agent task success, safe execution, or Jev parity.
